data.title: Iran: Oman deal in 'final stages,' but US must act to open Strait of Hormuz | The Jerusalem Post
data.description: A US official said on Friday that an agreement between Iran and Oman was close and could reopen the strait, which carried a fifth of global oil and liquefied natural gas shipments before the war.
